props.gloss_en: the mishna: if [the 14th] falls on Shabbat eve, villages advance to the day of assembly
the mishna: ...and large towns read on that day
the mishna: ...and walled cities read on that day
whose is the mishna? either Rebbi or R' Yosei (a disjunction: gloss-only, see header)
TK of baraita A: on a Friday 14th villages advance to the day of assembly
TK of baraita A: large towns too advance to the day of assembly
TK of baraita A: walled cities read on that day
Rebbi: the towns are not moved from their place; both these and those read on that day
TK's reason: 'in every year' (Esther 9:27) -- as every year the towns precede the walled cities, so here the towns precede the walled cities
Rebbi's reason: 'in every year' -- as every year the towns are not moved from their place, so here they are not moved
TK of baraita B: on a Friday 14th walled cities advance to the day of assembly
TK of baraita B: villages too advance to the day of assembly
TK of baraita B: large towns read on that day
R' Yosei: the walled cities do not precede the towns; both these and those read on that day
TK's reason: 'in every year' -- as every year the towns read on the 14th and this one's time is not that one's, so here
R' Yosei's reason: 'in every year' -- as every year the walled cities do not precede the towns, so here
TK of baraita C: if [the 14th] falls on Shabbat, villages advance to the day of assembly
TK of baraita C: large towns read on Shabbat eve
TK of baraita C: walled cities [read] the next day
Rebbi: since the towns were moved from their place, let them be moved to the day of assembly
R' Chelbo in Rav Huna's name, as transmitted: Purim that falls on Shabbat -- all are moved to the day of assembly
rather [Rav Huna said]: whatever is moved is moved to the day of assembly
in accordance with whom [is Rav Huna's dictum]? with Rebbi
at any rate all agree: the Megilla is not read on Shabbat
Rabba: all are obligated in the Megilla reading, and not all are expert in it -- a decree lest one take it in his hand to go to an expert to learn, and carry it four amot in the public domain
and this is the reason for the shofar [not being blown on Shabbat]
and this is the reason for the lulav [not being taken on Shabbat]
Rav Yosef: because the eyes of the poor are raised to the Megilla reading
the baraita as cited: even though they said villages advance to the day of assembly, they collect on that day and distribute on that day
the baraita as emended: since they said villages advance to the day of assembly, they collect and distribute on that day, because the eyes of the poor are raised to the Megilla reading
but rejoicing is practised only in its time
Rav: the Megilla in its time is read even by an individual
not in its time -- with ten
Rav Asi: both in its time and not in its time -- with ten
there was an incident, and Rav was concerned for this [view] of Rav Asi
Rav (via Rav Yehuda son of Rav Shmuel bar Shilat): Purim that falls on Shabbat -- Shabbat eve is their time
(entertained) is this not what he meant: not in its time is like its time -- as in its time even alone, so not in its time even alone?
no -- [it was not said] about reading with ten; 'Shabbat eve is their time' comes to exclude Rebbi, who said since the towns were moved they are moved to the day of assembly
this teaches us that Shabbat eve is their [the towns'] time
